name: Two-Font Consulting
tagline: Warm paper-beige ground with navy Fraunces serif headlines, Inter body, emerald accent, hatched corner pattern and white stat cards (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Paper beige with deep navy ink, emerald accent and mint on navy cards

typography.style: Bold Fraunces serif action titles over small-caps Inter kickers, with Fraunces numerals in stat cards

best_for: Argument-led decks where each slide carries a full-sentence takeaway title and supporting evidence. Suits consulting, public-sector and finance audiences.
avoid_for: Playful, youth-oriented or visually led launches that need big imagery.
